ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 45 percent high-intensity white to 55 percent low-intensity black pixels across the visible ventral fluke surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Two large asymmetrical white regions on the lobes; the right lobe contains a larger contiguous white patch extending toward the distal tip. High-frequency stippled mottling occurs at the interior boundaries where the white patches meet the solid black central region.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped notch with an estimated pixel angle of 35 degrees and a deep vertical indentation relative to the lobe height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serrations along the trailing edge boundary, characterized by low-amplitude peaks and valleys visible against the water background.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curve along the primary span of both lobes, tapering to sharp points at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Dense, high-contrast clusters of roughly circular white and brown pixel groups (barnacle colonization) localized specifically at the extreme distal tips of both fluke lobes.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Heavy accumulation of acorn barnacles on the lateral tips, creating a jagged, non-pigmentary texture; small circular white spots (likely healed scars) are visible within the black pigmentation of the peduncle area.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique 'feathered' or 'spray' pixel distribution at the medial-ventral transition zones on both lobes.
